summary: This bill directs the Comptroller General to study the effects of inflation and cost-of-living increases on Social Security and Medicare and recommend legislative actions to ensure the programs can provide full benefits.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on Social Security and Medicare, which are core components of the social safety net. It directs a study on their resiliency and the impact of inflation, with recommendations for legislative actions to ensure full benefits. This directly relates to the stability and potential expansion or reduction of these programs.
